about: Criterion 6's test canvas module and planted sources, which the implementer builds behind deep-show's cargo feature test-column-source (README: The column view). The tests read the expected values from this file.

planted.keeps_previous_rows: a source whose rows change with t that, after a seek, hands the view the rows of the frame before the seek instead of a clean evaluation at the new t
planted.reports_no_changes: a source whose values change with t that reports no changed index ranges after any step
